prerequisites: Proof of participation in a calibration test

learning_outcomes.text: Students can successfully complete an interdisciplinary and integrative design assignment under supervision.
Model objects using Computer Aided Design.
Develop a critical attitude, independence, and sense of responsibility.

syllabus_topics: The technical design process and the positioning of the design process in the product life cycle and project planning (1.5 h)
Modeling and assembly of objects via CAD (2h)
Techniques for making cross-sections to visualize internal shapes
Design and material realization of an electromechanical, controlled system (type assignment, closed problem)
Application of (basic) aspects from first and second semester courses: mathematics, mechanics, electrical networks, materials science, and computer science
Electronic design and soldering of the electrical circuit
Performing necessary experiments and calculations using Matlab

assessment_methods.method: Daily work (process evaluation), final team result (product evaluation), adherence to agreements and deadlines
Individual permanent evaluation of CAD exercises

assessment_rules: The team score is individually adjusted by peer assessment. For an insufficient grade on the teamwork component, a student will receive an individual assignment at the beginning of the summer period, including theoretical and practical parts, leading to a written report and presentation. CAD exercises must be redone if the grade on this component is insufficient.
